title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/campaign/scenario-rewards.yaml
description: The rewards of a scenario expressed as what they give the warband: a resource, a loot chart, or a bonus on the exploration phase. Every reward is identified by a `scenario.<slug>.<reward>` id and every loot row by `scenario.<slug>.loot.<row>`, so the applications can present a reward the player resolves at the table without reading the scenario prose again.

scenarios.description: One entry per scenario that declares rewards. A scenario without rewards has no entry — the absence is documented in the scenario's `progression.notes`.

scenario_id.description: Scenario of `scenarios.yaml` the rewards belong to; the catalogue never repeats the scenario's identity.

reward.description: One reward. `kind` is the discriminator: a resource the warband gains, a chart it rolls on, or a bonus on a later phase.

resource_reward.description: A resource the warband gains. The amount is resolved in play (the source states it as a rule, not as a number), so the reward declares which resource and whether the player has to enter a quantity.

rule.description: How the amount is determined, faithful to the source.

quantity_input.description: Whether the player enters the resolved quantity when the reward is applied.

loot_table_reward.description: A chart the warband rolls on for treasure.

rule.description: When and how the chart is rolled, faithful to the source.

manual_resolution.description: Whether the chart is resolved by hand at the table instead of by the application — the source's own `roll for each item separately` cases.

exploration_reward.description: A bonus the warband applies on the exploration phase of the same post-battle sequence.

reroll_all.description: Whether the bonus re-rolls every exploration die rather than a selection of them.

loot_row.description: One row of a loot chart: what is found, the roll that finds it and, when the source discriminates, the interval and the side.

label.description: What the row gives, as printed, e.g. `3D6 gold crowns`.

roll.description: The roll that reaches the row, as printed: `2D6`, `6-8` or `automatic`.

availability.description: The roll a player must pass for the row's reward to still be there, when the scenario declares one.

target.description: Value the roll must reach, when the source states one.

grant.description: What a loot row grants. `kind` is the discriminator: a catalogue item, a resource, or a special reward the item catalogue does not cover.

quantity_input.description: Whether the player enters the quantity when the reward is applied.
Whether the player enters the quantity when the reward is applied.

grant_special.description: Grants a special reward the item catalogue does not define, named by its own id instead of being invented as an item.

special_id.description: Id of the special reward, e.g. `cloak-of-mists` or a scenario reward id.

quantity_input.description: Whether the player enters the quantity when the reward is applied.
